summary: CGI Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its management's discussion and analysis and unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements for the three and six months ended March 31, 2026 and 2025. This is a routine earnings report no special-situation event. The filing includes a press release dated April 29, 2026, regarding results and forward-looking statements. No specific deal terms, strategic actions, or corporate events are disclosed. Registrant acts as issuer filing ordinary periodic results. The non-US registrant is reporting under Canadian securities rules; the filing is equivalent to a US Form 10-Q earnings release.
